## Scope

- Primary loop: Product Loop / Engineering Loop
- Risk: P0 / P1 / P2
- User scenario or engineering evidence:
- Affected ownership boundaries:

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests passed
- [ ] Relevant build passed
- [ ] `git diff --check` passed
- [ ] Manual, simulator, or signed-device evidence is attached or explicitly marked unavailable

## MemoMark Design System

- [ ] The page retains one primary responsibility
- [ ] The page has no more than one Primary Button
- [ ] Any new blue element has a necessary interactive or semantic role
- [ ] Any new icon communicates more clearly than text alone
- [ ] Any new Card owns a distinct object, decision, or status group
- [ ] Fields remain text-first and decorative icons are avoided
- [ ] Informational labels and badges are not styled as buttons
- [ ] Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, Reduce Motion, localization, and appearance impact were reviewed
- [ ] Configuration, Presentation, Layout, Renderer, Export, and Share ownership boundaries remain intact

Design-system exceptions must identify the product reason, owner, and visual verification evidence.
